verifiedDefect.rootCause: The research-task boundary computed the stage transition from the trusted PR base (main). The Binance task root is absent at that base, so checkStageTransition treated the whole cumulative root as a fresh creation (isCreation=true) and required head state PREPARED, rejecting RESEARCH_CAPTURED and the populated 20-research-output as 'not part of the deterministic factory skeleton'.

unmodifiedByDesign: .github/workflows/cbw-researchops-factory-validate.yml (no change needed; already passes trusted base/head with full non-shallow history)
research-ops/factory-v1-1/lib/stage.mjs (canonical transition/inventory/history rules unchanged and reused verbatim per segment)

trustModel.layerA: Preserved unchanged: cumulative trusted PR base -> head path-scope enforcement (single governed task root, no factory/workflow/application/other-root escape, forbidden areas, deletion/rename guards, task identity and branch binding). No path-scope check was removed or narrowed to the last commit.
trustModel.layerB: When the task root is absent at the trusted PR base, the CLI resolves the task's real mutation chain from trusted Git objects only: it walks the trusted head's COMPLETE first-parent ancestry and records only commits whose task-root TREE object changes. Topology and tree identity are the sole authority.
failClosedOn: more than one introduction (re-introduction / parallel history)
earliest edge not an ABSENT introduction
head tree != final segment head tree
trustModel.mainSyncMerge: A merge whose task-root tree is byte-identical to its first parent produces no mutation segment and is ignored; a merge that changes the task-root tree is rejected (no non-deterministic predecessor guessing).

algorithm.walk: first-parent only, from trusted head to the root commit (bounded by maxDepth); task-root tree read at most once per commit via carry-forward
algorithm.segment: each first-parent edge whose task-root tree changes; introduction = edge with null base tree
algorithm.perSegmentValidation: canonical checkStageTransition (introduction: taskExistsAtBase=false -> exact PREPARED skeleton; later: base->head transition + exact stage additions) and checkHistoryAppendOnly on trusted base/head TASK_STATE blobs

topologyCases: 030-3 unchanged main-sync merge creates no segment
030-5 arbitrary HEAD^ not trusted (real predecessor resolved)
030-7 root absent at head fails closed

limitations: Correction is control-plane Factory CI logic only. It does not re-run, modify or merge PR #69, does not itself capture the Binance research, and does not begin Source Truth Review. READY does not authorize merge.
nextSeparatelyAuthorizedStep: After independent owner audit and approval of this correction, a separate authorization merges it to main; the KZ-Binance inline-handoff capture (029) can then be re-run against the corrected workflow so PR #69 validates PREPARED -> RESEARCH_CAPTURED.
